name: Iconix Brand Group, Inc.
note: American brand-management company (New York), trading as Iconix International; its brands include Umbro. It went private on 4 August 2021 (SEC Form 8-K) when Iconix Acquisition LLC completed its tender offer and merger; Avram Glazer and the Avram Glazer Irrevocable Exempt Trust control Iconix Acquisition LLC, and the trust is its sole member (Offer to Purchase, 2 July 2021). Avram Glazer is the managing member of Lancer Capital LLC.
